posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
I definitely feel less guilty about my PSA on medical care last week since this week everybody was calling Christopher out more directly, heh.

Also hearing that Christopher just stands all day long makes me wonder how the fellow still has functioning legs even when he’s not getting injuries.

I’ve been an avid walker my whole life but mostly sedentary outside of that, and my knees are still basically non-existent now thanks to early-onset arthritis about 10-20 years ahead of schedule. I am to my eternal irritation much less able to walk everywhere as blithely as a result.

posts.name: FrivYeti
posts.cooked:
I think Christopher could handily win a fencing competition against Bunker, provided it was foil fencing and it was against Bunker, not Tyler Vance. Bunker would struggle to get his foil down to tap Christopher on the chest without touching his head or arms, while Christopher could run up, reach up, and tap Bunker on the chest fairly easily.

Also, I feel as though maybe Christopher and Adam struggled to understand the Guise question; it seemed like even with the clarification, they were still answering a different question than was being asked. My understanding of the question was “if a Guise falls in the woods and there’s no one there to read him, does he make a sound?”, i.e. is Guise capable of experiencing any moments or activities that don’t take place in front of a reader, viewer, or player?

My assumption is yes, because the alternative would probably leave him substantially nonfunctional; at the very least, he’s able to reference things that happened off-panel as though they happened to him, which we’ve seen him do more than once.

posts.name: Chief Lackey Rich
posts.cooked:
There’s no way you’re getting the Bunker suit equipped with properly-fitting safety gear, so participating in a formal fencing competition is right out. Even the lowest-level competitive meets call for approved fencing pants at a minimum (because getting accidentally stabbed in the crotch is no fun even with blunted weapons), which don’t exist in the suit’s sizes. I’m pretty sure you couldn’t find socks for it either, although I think you’re allowed to use homemade ones. Maybe if he asks nicely Maia would knit him a pair for the holidays?

Probably a violation of rules against wearing unapproved armor too, now that I think of it.
